mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.member_id, t.category_id, t.title, t.content, t.due_date, t.completed, t.created_at, t.updated_at, c.name AS category_name FROM todo t LEFT JOIN category c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo (member_id, category_id, title, content, due_date, completed) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{dueDate}, #{completed})
mapper.update: UPDATE todo SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, due_date = #{dueDate}, completed = #{completed}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
